4th Period.workingNow: Drafting your persuasive article on the best way to use AI, using this week's research as evidence.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A persuasive 'How I Think We Should Use AI' article live on your portfolio site — your argued position on the best way to use AI, backed by this week's research, plus at least one image — pushed to GitHub Pages by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can write a persuasive article stating and defending my opinion on the best way to use AI, using evidence from this week's research, so that readers understand and consider my point of view.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.IC.20 — Discuss the ethical and societal impacts of computing technologies (approximate — verify against your standards doc).
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas and information clearly.
agenda: Warm-Up: pick your strongest research fact (3 min)
Quick overview: persuasive article structure (3 min)
I do: model claim + reasoning + evidence (8 min)
We do: build one shared example paragraph (7 min)
You do: draft your article — claim + 3 reasons (24 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your opening claim sentence (5 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you learned what not to share with AI, then researched its bigger risks and benefits as a class. Today you turn all of that into your own argument — due, with an image, on your site by Sunday night.
